assumptions: Each successful TryAcquire or completed AcquireAsync is paired with exactly one Release by its owner.
A PermitGate instance is constructed with a positive capacity and never shared across processes.
limits: Acquire models the enqueue or immediate grant; Resume models completion of the returned task, including failure after Close.
state_mapping has no field for granted: a handed-over permit whose waiter has not resumed is not visible in PermitGate fields, so traces do not compare it.
No claim about scheduling delay between a handoff and the waiter's continuation.
Inspection is not machine-checked implementation refinement; the listed guarantees are outstanding obligations.
